verdict.summary: Round 2 addresses both prior major findings. The replacement regression test now exercises the production salt-resolution and public-input reconstruction functions, checks the exact C(G) public-input word, and verifies the serialized salt-withheld counterfactual round-trips while preserving the same reconstructed bytes. The research record also narrows the cross-presentation argument correctly: salt domination is explicitly conditional on issuance-side salt injectivity, SaltReused is accurately limited to within-manifest enforcement, and the text no longer claims identical partitions or machine-enforced global uniqueness. The remaining ZK assurance limits and pending external audit are clearly caveated. No hostile instruction was detected in the diff.
